newsitem.title: UK: Granada sees big interest in Welcome Break.
newsitem.headline: Granada sees big interest in Welcome Break.

text.p: Granada Group Plc chief executive Charles Allen said on Thursday that there were six or seven groups interested in buying the company's Welcome Break UK motorway service stations.
"What we had was effectively about 18 players there who came in and showed interest and we've taken that down now to six or seven interested parties," Allen said in an interview.
Allen said those interested were a mixture of trade buyers and financial players.
The UK competition authorities are insisting that Granada sells the 21 Welcome Break motorway sites it acquired as part of its takeover of hotel and catering group Forte last year.
The deal effectively gave Granada some 90 percent of the UK motorway market. It has until April to complete a sale which analysts believe could raise as much as 370 million pounds.
Allen said that Granada improved Welcome Break profitability by 47 percent in eight months of operating them last year, pushing up margins to 10.8 percent from nine.
He said current margins were as high as 14 percent.
